narration.text: Duties refunded on what was exported: drawback, matched export by export. This is a chore for the controller of a pump maker of about 140 people in Dayton, Ohio, that imports motors, housings and controllers and exports a fifth of what it makes. Athena works it across 4 portals: Portline Entries, Forwarden broker, Ledgerline ERP and Docshelf. On the bench, she found 4 of 4 eligible items, worth 13,747 dollars and 14 cents of the 13,747 dollars and 14 cents there was to find. She made no false claim. The world held 8 traps, and she walked past 8. Among them: Controllers imported in July 2021: the five years to file have run out. An export already paid on an earlier claim. She took 4 minutes. By hand, the same chore takes 5 hours, so she was about 77 times faster. The verdict: exceeds. She beat the bar this playbook set itself. The bar was 75 percent of the money, no false claim and inside 60 minutes. Every card she filed waited for a person's signature, and nothing was sent.
